 Standout star from the right powers Paris Saint-Germain 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Achraf Hakimi put Paris Saint-Germain in front in the 28th minute with a ruthless finish, then completed a hat-trick and two assists to seal a 5-1 win away to Le Havre .
 He had already unlocked the hosts by cushioning a pass for Mika Godts to sweep in (26.). Moments later, he raced onto Senny Mayulu's through ball and finished, with VAR awarding the goal after an offside check (28.).
 OneFootball Videos
 After the restart, he bent a low free kick around the wall into the bottom right corner (55.). He then threaded a pass in behind for Mayulu to round Arnaud Bodart and score (62.).
 The hat-trick arrived when his initial effort was saved but rebounded in off him (69.). He finished with six attempts, five on target, plus two assists and three key passes, repeatedly arriving free inside the box.
 PSG 's structure kept him high on the right, his runs beyond the line and quick combinations with the wide forwards dragging Le Havre out of shape and tilting the key phases Paris' way.
 Paris Saint-Germain visit Villarreal in the Champions League next, while Le Havre host Lorient in Ligue 1.
 How high would you rate Hakimi's performance tonight?
